report.summary: Focused review of the cloneJson cycle repair and new tests in seller-dom-adapter.mjs. The ancestor-path cycle check correctly permits acyclic aliasing (e.g., requests[0].response also used as receipt) while rejecting true cycles. Node/depth/byte budgets continue to count the expanded JSON representation. New tests cover the sharing scenario and true cycle rejection. No reproducible defects found in the repaired logic or tests.
limitations: Review limited to supplied source and tests; no runtime environment or external dependencies were available.
The review is based on static analysis of the provided code; dynamic behavior in a real DOM environment may differ.
Potential interactions with other parts of the system outside the supplied files are not considered.
